summary.strategy: implement all currently authorized work first on the execution branch; one consolidated verification at the end; no per-lane three-lens verification; per-integration hygiene only (affected unit tests, builder --check, syntax/schema validity)
summary.main: no merge to main in this phase; main eef8b85 is the protected post-A9.4 baseline; a new merge approval is requested only after the consolidated verification
summary.p1q16: definitive: I_e,cap = I_e,collector,RFON - I_e,collector,RFOFF, signed algebraic currents; no absolute values, zero clipping, replacement of negative results, or Hall-ON capacity evidence
summary.p1q15_denominator: max(|I_e,collector|, I_scale,min); instrument adequacy 3 u_R > 0.02 |I_e,collector| -> NOT_EVALUATED_INSTRUMENT
stop_conditions: a genuinely new owner decision is unavoidable
implementation would require inventing scientific evidence
implementation would require a purchase/payment/external commitment
a safety-critical ambiguity prevents even framework implementation
all currently implementable work is complete
summary.unresolved_questions: genuine design choices depending on P1/P2 data, measured I_d,max,H1, vendor quotations, material data, measured thermal coupling or facility capability stay TBD_OWNER (or the existing equivalent)

implementation_lanes.fo_a9_6_mass_power_integration: mass BOM + power integration for the current architecture (sec. 11)
implementation_lanes.fo_a9_6_decision_propagation: propagate decided questions; owner-question state v4 (sec. 5-7)
